neighbours.label: a player's first name in a school sports game recap (e.g. 'junior Ryan', 'sophomore Austin')
fire: Sandpoint junior Ryan Miller led all scorers with 22 points on Friday night.
Sophomore Austin Reed tied for third overall in the cross-country meet.
Led by catcher Kyle Evans, the Tigers won their fifth straight game.
Senior Brandon Lee hit both free throws to put the Eagles ahead.
Freshman Tyler Brooks scored twice in the second half of the match.
Point guard Jordan Hayes added nine assists and four steals.
Rookie Shane Cooper had another solid night with two goals.
Midfielder Logan Price set up the winning goal in overtime.
